It emphasizes simple and clean designs, uses fabrics such as Giza cotton and linen, and ensures proper tailoring. The brand aims to provide comfortable and well-fitted clothing suitable for customers in different regions.

about_short_description.short_description: Carter & White is an online store that offers a wide selection of apparel and accessories for men, women, and kids.

product.name: Men's Apparel
product.description: Clothing items designed for men including shirts, t-shirts, shorts, trousers, polo shirts, jackets, knitwear, sweatshirts, sweatpants, loungewear, sleepwear, and undergarments.

product.name: Women's Apparel
product.description: Clothing items for women including shirts, blouses, dresses, skirts, t-shirts, shorts, trousers, jackets, knitwear, co-ord sets, sweatpants, sweatshirts, loungewear, sleepwear, and accessories.

product.name: Children's Apparel
product.description: Clothing for boys and girls including shirts, t-shirts, shorts, trousers, knitwear, sleepwear, sweatshirts, sweatpants, undergarments, and accessories.

product.name: Home Textiles
product.description: Products for home including bed linens, duvet covers, pillow cases, fitted sheets, flat sheets, throws, towels, bath mats, bathrobes, and bathroom accessories.

product.name: Yacht Linens and Accessories
product.description: Specialized linens and accessories designed for yacht interiors including bespoke yacht linens and yacht bed linens.

product.name: Footwear
product.description: A selection of women's footwear including sandals, mules, and slingbacks made from materials like leather, suede, and grosgrain.
